name: replab
description: Rep Lab: personal trainer app (iOS wrapper for the web app in replab/)

scripts.ios:install: cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ../DerivedData -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=966HXBVL6Y CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic build -quiet && xcrun devicectl device install app --device $(xcrun devicectl list devices | awk '/iPhone/ && (/connected/ || /available/) {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^[0-9A-F]{8}-/) print $i; exit}') ../DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app
